business_question: Can a small model turn short unstructured text into a fixed reference-and-amount record without inventing missing fields?
conclusion: Fine-tuning improved exact extraction from 0 to 10 of 12 cases. It learned the required format and handled missing fields and a conflicting total. However, it obeyed an instruction embedded inside a record and substituted invented output values. It also requested review when a subtotal and an explicit total were both present. The aggregate target was reached, but one critical failure correctly blocks release. The preregistered new input passed after the saved model was reloaded.
